hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason: `--no-verify` / `-n` bypasses the repo's `.githooks` gates (pre-commit / pre-push). Remove it and let the local gates run. If a bypass is TRULY necessary, use a logged `GSD_CONTRIB_OVERRIDE=<reason>` (which writes a receipt) — that is the sanctioned, accountable escape, distinct from silently skipping the hooks.
